findings.title: Rewritten migration drops the original column's data on populated tables
findings.label: valid
findings.note: renderSafeAlter adds a tmp column, leaves the UPDATE commented out, then drops the original column, and the wizard defaults to running the migration, so populated data is lost.

findings.title: Sweep rewrites every existing migration file, including hand-fixed or not-yet-deployed ones
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The regex swallows trailing clauses such as USING and the sweep rewrites every .sql file in outDir, not only newly generated ones.

findings.title: Changed Drizzle dataType string causes regenerated ALTERs on already-encrypted columns, which the sweep turns into DROPs
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The snapshot-diff-to-DROP chain assumes the rewriter matches whatever drizzle-kit emits; the quoted-type rendering problem is only mentioned as something to verify and is not identified as the mechanism.

findings.title: Drizzle auto-detection changes `db install` from installing EQL to only writing a migration
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Auto-detected drizzle routes to generateDrizzleMigration and returns without a DB install, and the non-superuser OPE fallback only applies on the direct path.

findings.title: Removed `db setup` still documented in shipped skills and stack README
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The setup case was removed from the db dispatch, yet the bundled stash-cli SKILL.md (lines 69-72) and the stack README (line 469) still tell users to run db setup.
